news.title: Caltech physicists finally measure a quantum energy ladder predicted 40 years ago
news.summary: Researchers have experimentally observed energy patterns that physicists have predicted for about 40 years. The technique could now be used to explore mysterious quantum systems where scientists do not already know the answer.
